title: Webb County Constable Pct. 1 joins Malakoff Elementary's Veterans Day program
excerpt: Webb County Constable Pct. 1 attended the Veterans Day program at Malakoff Elementary School on Thursday morning, joining students and staff in honoring U.S. veterans.
content:
Webb County Constable Pct. 1 joined the Veterans Day program at Malakoff Elementary School on Thursday morning, Nov. 13, 2026.

The constable's office thanked Malakoff Elementary and its staff for the invitation and for putting together the tribute to veterans.

"To all our veterans, thank you for your service, sacrifice, and dedication. We honor you today and every day," the constable's office said.

Source: Webb County Constable Pct. 1 (Facebook), Nov. 13, 2026.
